name: Earth Zoom Into My Clip
description: From space down to your place: the Earth, a dive through the clouds, a satellite view with the place name, a drone view, then your own clip plays untouched with its sound. A photo alone gives a zoom loop. 9:16.

clip.label: A short outdoor clip (2-10 s), or a photo of a place
clip.drop: Drop a short outdoor clip or a photo of a place here, or tap to choose one
clip.fine: Your own footage or a photo you took. Places only: no faces needed. Nothing leaves this machine.
